findings.issue: No test runner, no test script, and no tests anywhere in the app; the external acceptance suite is the only guard.
findings.suggestion: Add `npm run qwik add vitest` (Qwik's documented path: vitest with the qwikCity/qwikVite plugins, `createDOM` from @builder.io/qwik/testing), plus a `test` script wired into CI.

findings.issue: Home-page filtering, 48-per-page pagination and page clamping are untested; off-by-one or clamp bugs (page=999, page=0, last-page Next link) would slip through.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the loader's filter/slice/clamp behaviour against a small fake index, including boundary pages and the zero-match `No Pokémon found` branch.

findings.issue: The subtlest logic in the repo — nulls-last in both sort directions, mixed string/number comparison, level-up default order, name tie-breaks, aria-sort flips — is untested.
findings.suggestion: Extract sortRows-style tests over MoveRow fixtures covering null power/accuracy, ascending/descending flips and tie-break ordering.

findings.issue: cardsFor (Pokémon→species mapping, id>10000 exclusion, dedupe, hidden flag) is the exact path the acceptance data-overlay stresses, and has no regression net.
findings.suggestion: Test cardsFor with a stubbed speciesNames map covering deoxys-normal→deoxys style aliases, alternate forms, duplicates and hidden abilities.

findings.issue: Client-side URL-state machinery (200 ms debounce, replaceState navigation, the document.activeElement guard at :91-97) is untested; a timer or race refactor breaks search silently.
findings.suggestion: Cover with a Playwright component/e2e test that types and asserts the URL and result list update without Enter.

findings.issue: The in-memory cache is untested: rejected promises are handed to concurrent callers before eviction, cache keys ignore API_BASE_URL, and 404-as-null is cached for 60 s.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test api() against a stubbed fetch: 404→null, non-ok→throw, TTL expiry, and that a failed request is not sticky.

findings.issue: Game selection logic — ?game= validation, default-to-highest-order, and query preservation in the select handler (:241-249) — is untested.
findings.suggestion: Test the loader with ?game=<invalid>, ?game=<valid>, and omitted, plus the select's URL rewriting with other params present.

findings.issue: 404 paths (status(404)+NotFound) across all four detail loaders and the [...rest] catch-all are untested.
findings.suggestion: One parametrized test per route asserting status 404 and the rendered NotFound for a bogus slug.

findings.issue: Trivially testable pure helpers (humanize, dexNumber zero-padding, orDash em-dash) are untested.
findings.suggestion: A dozen one-line vitest cases would pin the display-name and em-dash rules the spec spells out.

findings.issue: idFromUrl silently returns NaN for URLs without a trailing numeric segment, poisoning every id-keyed map downstream.
findings.suggestion: Test idFromUrl against '/api/v2/pokemon/25/', trailing-slash-less URLs and garbage; decide explicitly what happens on NaN.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, script, or spec files — despite most of its risky logic (pagination, sorting, species mapping, URL state, 404s) living in plain exported functions that are cheap to test. Qwik's current documented setup (`npm run qwik add vitest`, @builder.io/qwik/testing) is entirely absent. Once the external acceptance suite is no longer the only guard, any refactor of the data layer or table sorting will regress undetected.
